What is HTML?
HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language, which is the most widely used language on Web to develop web pages.
Who created HTML?
HTML was created by Berners-Lee in late 1991.
What are the different versions of HTML?
HTML was first published in 1995 as HTML 2.0, then in 1999 as HTML 4.01, and currently we have HTML-5 version published in 2012.
Who is the target audience for this tutorial?
This tutorial is designed for aspiring Web Designers and Developers with a need to understand HTML in enough detail along with its simple overview, and practical examples.
What are the prerequisites for this tutorial?

Before proceeding with this tutorial, you should have a basic working knowledge with Windows or Linux operating system, additionally you must be familiar with: experience with any text editor like notepad, notepad++, or Edit plus etc., how to create directories and files on your computer, how to navigate through different directories, how to type content in a file and save them on a computer, understanding about images in different formats like JPEG, PNG format.

What is the purpose of the <DOCTYPE> declaration in HTML?
The <DOCTYPE> declaration defines the document type and version of HTML being used.
What are the basic HTML tags?
What are the core attributes in HTML?
Core attributes in HTML include 'id', 'class', 'href', 'src', 'alt', 'title', 'type', 'value', 'name', and 'for'.
What is the difference between an HTML tag and an HTML element?

An HTML tag is the opening and closing part of an HTML element, while an HTML element is the content between the tags. For example,

Can you explain how to nest HTML elements?

What are the main formatting elements in HTML?
HTML provides several formatting elements such as bold text, italic text, underlined text, strike text, and monospaced font.
How do you apply bold text in HTML?
You apply bold text using the <b> tag or the <strong> tag.
What is the difference between <b> and <strong> tags?
<b> is used for stylistic text, while <strong> is used to indicate strong importance.
How do you apply italic text in HTML?
You apply italic text using the <i> tag or the <em> tag.
What are the different HTML phrase tags mentioned in the text?
The text mentions 'Emphasized Text', which is an HTML phrase tag.
What does the 'Emphasized Text' tag do in HTML?
The 'Emphasized Text' tag is used to make text appear in a different style, typically bold or italic.
Can you explain the difference between 'Emphasized Text' and 'Strong Text' in HTML?
Emphasized Text is used for text that is not as important as Strong Text, which is used for text that is more important.
What is the purpose of the <strong> tag in HTML?
The <strong> tag is used to emphasize text, making it bold.
What does the <abbr> tag represent in HTML?
The <abbr> tag is used to define an abbreviation or acronym.
How do you write text in a right-to-left direction in HTML?
To write text in a right-to-left direction, you can use the dir attribute with the value 'rtl'.
What is the difference between <em> and <strong> tags in HTML?
<em> is used to emphasize text, while <strong> is used to make text bold.
What are the main sections of an HTML document?
The main sections of an HTML document include the <head> and <body> tags.
What is the purpose of the <head> tag in an HTML document?
The <head> tag contains meta-information about the document, such as the title, character set, and scripts.
What is the purpose of the <body> tag in an HTML document?
The <body> tag contains the content of the document, such as text, images, and links.
What is the purpose of the 'Document Description' section in HTML?
What is the difference between valid and invalid HTML comments?
How are multiline comments handled in HTML?
What is the purpose of conditional comments in HTML?
Conditional comments are used to apply different styles or scripts based on the browser version. They are typically used in older versions of Internet Explorer.
How do you insert an image into an HTML document?
You insert an image using the tag, specifying the source URL with the 'src' attribute.
What is the difference between 'set image location' and 'set image width/height' in HTML?
Setting the image location involves specifying where the image should be displayed on the page, while setting the width and height adjusts the size of the image.
How do you set an image border in HTML?
You can set an image border by using the 'border' attribute within the tag.
What is the purpose of the <table> tag in HTML?
The <table> tag is used to create a table in HTML.
What are the attributes used to style a table in HTML?
The cellpadding and cellspacing attributes are used to style a table in HTML.
What is the difference between colspan and rowspan attributes in HTML?
Colspan allows a cell to span multiple columns, while rowspan allows a cell to span multiple rows.
How can I add a background color to a table in HTML?
You can add a background color to a table in HTML using the bgcolor attribute.
What are the main sections of an HTML document?
The main sections of an HTML document are the header, body, and footer.
What is a nested table in HTML?
A nested table is a table that is contained within another table.
What are HTML lists?
HTML lists are used to organize content in a structured way.
What is the type attribute in HTML lists?
The type attribute in HTML lists specifies the type of list (e.g., bullet points, numbers).
What are some common attributes used in HTML links?

The target attribute specifies where to open the linked document. Common values include _blank, _self, _parent, and _top. The base path attribute specifies the base URL for relative links. The href attribute specifies the URL of the linked document.
How can I create a download link in HTML?
To create a download link in HTML, you use the <a> tag with the href attribute set to the URL of the file you want to download, and the download attribute set to the desired filename.
What is the purpose of the download dialog box in HTML?

The download dialog box is a security feature that prompts the user to confirm whether they want to download a file. It helps prevent malicious scripts from automatically downloading files without the user's consent.
What are some best practices for creating effective HTML links?
To create effective HTML links, use descriptive text that accurately describes the link's destination. Avoid using generic text like
or

. Use the target attribute to specify where the link should open, and use the download attribute to create download links. Test links on different devices and browsers to ensure they work as expected.
What is the purpose of HTML email links?
HTML email links are used to create clickable links within email messages that direct users to a specific website or other resource.
What is the HTML tag used for creating email links?
The HTML tag used for creating email links is <a>.
What are the default settings for HTML email links?

The default settings for HTML email links include the href attribute, which specifies the URL to which the link points, and the target attribute, which specifies where to open the link (e.g., _blank for a new tab).
